text.description_html:
18 Inch Center to Center Square Refrigerator Pull

A pull for appliances in modern kitchens, this square handle was designed with popular design aesthetics in mind. Everything from the clean, sleek lines to the 3 available finishes--satin nickel, polished chrome, and oil rubbed bronze--are shinning examples of the styles that the most glamorous homes have. The 18 Inch Appliance Pull comes packaged with one pull and the mounting hardware to install on any large appliance door panel. Most often used as a refrigerator handle, this 18 Inch Center to Center Square Pull, can be used on almost any large kitchen appliance like a freezer or even dish washer.

Also Available Matching 18" Square Door Pull.

Specifications and Features of the Modern Square Appliance Handle:

  • Overall Length: 18-3/4"
  • Mounting Length: 18" Center to Center
  • Pull Diameter: 3/4" Square Tubing
  • Overall Projection: 2-13/32"
  • Clearance: 1-5/8"
  • Comes packaged mounting screws for a refrigerator/appliance door panel.

Sold Individually (1 door pull handle).
